name: cable-hip-abduction.html
instructions:
1. Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on a cable machine.
2. Stand next to the pulley machine and attach the ankle strap to the ankle furthest from the pulley machine.
3. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, and hold onto the machine or nearby support for balance.
4. Keeping your leg straight, lift the strapped leg out to the side, leading with the heel, and engage your glutes and hip muscles.
5. Pause, then slowly return your leg to the starting position with control, resisting the cable tension.
6. Perform the desired number of reps, then switch legs.
